title: Plania · Intelligent commercial and logistics planning
description: Connect the ERP you already have and find out what to discount, what to restock, what to re-price and how to route deliveries. An AI copilot on your real data. 7-day full trial, no card required.
hero_badge: For distributors, wholesalers and retailers in Uruguay and Latin America
hero_sub: Plania connects to the ERP you already have and tells you what to discount, what to restock, what to re-price and how to route deliveries. With a copilot that answers using your real numbers and hands you the report in PDF, Word or Excel.
hero_nota: No card required. Every feature enabled. Your data never leaves your machine.

plat_h: What it does for your business, every single day
plat_sub: This is not one more dashboard. Every screen ends in a concrete decision, with the reasoning in money.
f1_d: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite or CSV/Excel. It auto-detects your columns even when they are named differently. No migration, no consultants.
f2_d: "Which items should I discount this week?" "What do I restock today?" It answers by computing against your database and shows the table it used. It does not invent numbers.
f3_d: It spots the stock that stopped moving and works out a fair discount, never below cost plus 8%. It tells you exactly how much tied-up cash you release.
f4_d: It cross-checks real turnover against each supplier's lead time and tells you what to buy today, how much, and how much revenue is at risk if you wait.
f5_d: It finds the products selling below their category margin and suggests the new price with the monthly impact already calculated.
f6_d: It builds the day's routes per vehicle while minimising kilometres, with or without coordinates in your data. Export the route sheet and the truck rolls.
f7_d: It surfaces the cross-selling you are losing: which categories similar businesses buy in other zones and yours still does not.
f8_d: Every analysis and every copilot answer comes out as PDF, Word and Excel, ready to send to the owner, the buyer or the sales rep on the route.
